src/index.ts.overview: Process entry point that installs signal and unhandled-rejection handlers, then starts the on-chain listener, the Gold RWA loop and the JSON API in one Node process.

src/config.ts.overview: Central env-driven configuration: chain definitions (RPCs, explorers, DEX factories), quote tokens, alert thresholds, API settings and Gold RWA parameters.

src/listener.ts.overview: Subscribes to DEX factory pool-creation events and watched-wallet Transfer logs on Base and Ethereum, enriches them with market and safety data, and dispatches new-pool and whale-buy signals.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: onNewPool
sections.explanation: Handles a pool-creation log: picks the non-quote token, waits for indexing, gathers metadata, market and deployer, filters by safety and liquidity, and dispatches a new_pool signal.

sections.title: onWatchedTransfer
sections.explanation: Handles Transfer logs into watched wallets, prices the amount and dispatches whale_buy signals above WHALE_MIN_USD with a safety verdict.

sections.title: startListener
sections.explanation: Registers factory and watched-wallet Transfer subscriptions for Base and Ethereum.

src/wallets.ts.overview: Loads the smart-money/VC/insider watchlist from data/watchlist.json, skipping invalid addresses, and offers lookups by address and by chain.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: loadWatchlist
sections.explanation: Reads data/watchlist.json, keeps entries with valid 0x addresses, checksums them and fills label, category and chain defaults.

sections.title: lookupWallet
sections.explanation: Case-insensitive lookup of a watched wallet by address.

sections.title: watchedAddresses
sections.explanation: Returns the watched addresses enabled for a given chain.

src/filter.ts.overview: Token safety and market-data layer: viem clients, DexScreener market lookup, honeypot/tax simulation, explorer verification, LP burn check and deployer profile, combined into a PASS/WARN/REJECT verdict.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: makeClient
sections.explanation: Creates a viem public client for Base or Ethereum, preferring WebSocket RPC when configured.

sections.title: getMarket
sections.explanation: Fetches DexScreener pairs for a token and returns price, liquidity and market cap of the deepest-liquidity pair on the chain.

sections.title: checkHoneypot
sections.explanation: Queries honeypot.is to simulate buy/sell and report honeypot status and buy/sell tax.

sections.title: checkVerified
sections.explanation: Checks Basescan/Etherscan for verified contract source when an API key is configured.

sections.title: checkLiquidityLock
sections.explanation: Estimates the share of V2-style LP tokens sent to dead/zero addresses as a burn/lock heuristic.

sections.title: deployerProfile
sections.explanation: Returns the deployer's native balance and transaction count as a throwaway-wallet signal.

sections.title: tokenMeta
sections.explanation: Reads ERC-20 symbol, decimals and total supply with safe fallbacks.

sections.title: evaluateToken
sections.explanation: Runs all safety checks in parallel and folds them into PASS/WARN/REJECT with human-readable reasons.

sections.title: txFrom
sections.explanation: Resolves the sender of a transaction hash, or undefined on failure.

src/gold_rwa.ts.overview: Gold RWA monitor comparing PAXG and XAUt DEX prices with a spot gold feed, classifying spreads into alert/major levels and alerting only on level changes persisted in data/gold_state.json.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: fetchSpotGold
sections.explanation: Fetches the spot gold price per troy ounce from GOLD_SPOT_URL.

sections.title: dexQuote
sections.explanation: Gets the deepest-liquidity DexScreener price for a gold token on a chain.

sections.title: classify
sections.explanation: Maps an absolute spread percentage to none, alert or major.

sections.title: scanGold
sections.explanation: Builds one GoldQuote per configured asset with deviation, level and premium/discount direction.

sections.title: renderGoldAlert
sections.explanation: Formats the gold spread alert text with DEX vs spot prices, liquidity, status and thresholds.

sections.title: runGoldCycle
sections.explanation: One scan cycle: updates the snapshot, alerts on level changes per asset and persists levels to gold_state.json.

sections.title: startGoldLoop
sections.explanation: Runs a gold cycle now and then every GOLD_POLL_MS.

src/notifier.ts.overview: Defines the WhaleSignal shape and dispatches rendered alerts to stdout, Telegram and a generic webhook, recording every signal in the in-memory store.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: renderText
sections.explanation: Renders a signal into the multi-line alert text, or returns pre-rendered text for gold alerts.

sections.title: dispatch
sections.explanation: Records the signal, logs and prints it, then posts to Telegram and the webhook when configured.

src/store.ts.overview: In-memory ring buffer of the last 200 signals plus the latest Gold RWA snapshot, read by the HTTP API; resets on restart.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: recordSignal
sections.explanation: Prepends a signal to the bounded buffer, trimming it to 200 entries.

sections.title: listSignals
sections.explanation: Returns the newest signals of one kind up to a limit.

sections.title: countSignals
sections.explanation: Counts buffered signals per kind.

sections.title: setGoldSnapshot
sections.explanation: Stores the latest gold quotes, keeping the previous quotes when a scan returned none.

sections.title: getGoldSnapshot
sections.explanation: Returns the current gold snapshot.

src/api.ts.overview: Dependency-free node:http JSON API exposing /api/health, /api/gold, /api/whales and /api/pools with optional bearer-token auth and an origin allowlist for CORS.

sections.title: Imports and module setup
sections.explanation: Header comment, imports and module-level constants or types that the functions below rely on.

sections.title: health
sections.explanation: Builds the /api/health payload: uptime, watched wallet count, auth flag, gold scan timestamps and per-kind signal counts.

sections.title: goldPayload
sections.explanation: Builds the /api/gold payload with the latest quotes, thresholds and a stale flag when the snapshot is older than three poll intervals.

sections.title: handle
sections.explanation: Request router: answers CORS preflight, rejects non-GET methods, serves health without auth, enforces the bearer token, then routes gold/whales/pools.

sections.title: startApi
sections.explanation: Starts the HTTP server on the configured host and port unless API_ENABLED=false, logging request and server errors.

src/logger.ts.overview: Creates the shared pino structured logger whose level comes from LOG_LEVEL.

.env.example.overview: Template of every runtime environment variable: RPC endpoints, explorer keys, Telegram/webhook alert targets, whale and pool thresholds, Gold RWA settings, API host/port/token/CORS and log level.

README.md.overview: Project overview covering features, architecture diagram, Raspberry Pi 4 quick start, systemd auto-start, the HTTP JSON API, configuration, layout, alerts, troubleshooting and limitations.

package.json.overview: npm manifest for an ESM TypeScript app run with tsx, with start/listen/gold/typecheck/build scripts and viem, pino and dotenv dependencies.

tsconfig.json.overview: Strict TypeScript compiler settings targeting ES2022 ESM with bundler resolution, compiling src/ to dist/.

data/watchlist.json.overview: Seed watchlist template with placeholder smart-money, VC and insider-cluster wallets that must be replaced with verified addresses.

deploy/DEPLOY.md.overview: Step-by-step Raspberry Pi 4 deployment guide: prerequisites, clone, install, configure, smoke test, systemd install, operation and updates.

deploy/install-service.sh.overview: Installer script that checks npm and .env, installs dependencies, renders the systemd unit with the current user and path, enables the service and prints an API health check command.

deploy/whale-tracker.service.overview: Hardened systemd unit running `npm start` for the tracker with always-restart, no start limit and an optional .env EnvironmentFile.

docs/RPI4_DEPLOYMENT.md.overview: Raspberry Pi 4 deployment and OpenTerminal integration guide covering setup, verification, API settings, endpoints, CORS, custom wallets, Gold RWA parameters and troubleshooting.
